top_signals.title: New SVB Review Finds Fed Missed Repeated Warnings
top_signals.summary: A new draft report found that Federal Reserve officials failed to adequately respond to repeated warnings about Silicon Valley Bank’s deteriorating financial condition before its 2023 failure. The report by Starling Trust Sciences was commissioned by Federal Reserve Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman, who has long pushed for an outside review of SVB’s failure. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Binance brushes off Lagarde MiCA speculation, reaffirms Europe commitment
top_signals.summary: Binance declined to address reports of ECB intervention in its Greek MiCA bid, saying it remains committed to securing authorization in Europe.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: On Holdings New Partner; Netflix Analyst Downgrade | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- On Holding (ONON) is higher after it signed Kylian Mbappé as a partner in developing football products and representing the brand. The move marks On mounting a bold challenge to Nike and Adidas’ dominance of the sport.
- Xenon Pharmaceuticals (XENE) is in a steep decline after it voluntarily halted a trial enrollment of azetukalner, which treats depression and bipolar, after studies showed adverse events.
- Netflix (NFLX) shares are lower after Wells Fargo downgraded the stock to underweight, citing concerns about user engagement. Analyst Steven Cahall wrote that Netflix "has lacked big original series and it's showing" and that "breakout hits" are necessary for the stock to work again. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: California Gov. Newsom issues executive order to rein in AI 'before it's too late'
top_signals.summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom and other 2028 Democratic presidential hopefuls have called for a more aggressive approach to addressing AI fears.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
